lead.event: Ultra Jaya schedules a rights issue to fund its Frisian Flag acquisition
lead.headline: ULTJ schedules Rp16.94 trillion rights issue to fund Frisian Flag acquisition
lead.blurb: Ultra Jaya plans to issue 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, in a 15,200:11,517 ratio. About 86.01% of the proceeds will fund its planned acquisition of 100% of Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion, with the remainder for working capital. FCIH and two other parties will execute 6.77 billion rights, and FCIH will become ULTJ’s controlling shareholder. The cum-right date is 8 January 2027, with new shares due to list on 14 January 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Garuda Indonesia announces a rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GIAA announces rights issue of up to 248.71 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Shareholders approved it on 6 November at Rp58 to Rp68 a share, with up to 37.92% public dilution. Danantara Asset Management will contribute 82.1 billion Garuda Maintenance Facility Aero Asia shares worth Rp5.66 trillion, increasing Garuda Indonesia’s economic interest. Trading and execution are scheduled for 29 December to 7 January 2027.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indo Tambangraya conducts a Rp1.83 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ITMG conducts Rp1.83 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: From January to early November 2026, Indo Tambangraya bought 54.82 million shares, equal to 4.9% of its outstanding shares. It has announced a further Rp2.31 trillion buyback, scheduled to conclude in February 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Indonesia’s four largest banks report declining net interest margins in 9M26
earnings_guidance.headline: Indonesia’s largest banks report 9M26 NIM shifts as BMRI falls to 4.21%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s margin fell from 4.59%, while BCA’s declined to 5.41% from 5.76% and BRI’s to 6.16% from 6.53%. BNI’s rose to 3.76% from 3.47%. The banks are focusing on productive lending and low-cost funds, and Bank Mandiri cut its full-year NIM target to 4.3%–4.5% from 4.5%–4.7%.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom reports lower nine-month profit amid investment losses
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports nearly 4% nine-month profit decline to Rp14.45 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom said unrealized gains and losses totaling Rp1.66 trillion heavily influenced the decline, including losses of Rp759 billion on Telkomsel's GOTO investment and Rp794 billion at MDI Ventures. Operating income rose 3.54% to Rp113.5 trillion, but higher operating and administrative costs offset the increase.

earnings_guidance.event: Gudang Garam shares fall despite strong nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: GGRM shares fall 0.65% despite 308.56% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Gudang Garam reported net profit of Rp4.52 trillion, up from Rp1.1 trillion, while revenue declined 8.67% to Rp61.49 trillion. Separately, its Dhoho International Airport was designated a regular hajj airport for 2027, set to serve 9,641 pilgrims from 15 East Java regencies and cities.

earnings_guidance.event: Indo Tambangraya reports higher nine-month revenue and profit
earnings_guidance.headline: ITMG reports higher nine-month revenue and profit, net profit reaches US$162.93 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue was US$1.6 billion, including US$1.55 billion from third-party coal sales. Sales volume rose 5% and the average selling price increased 12% year on year to US$86 per ton.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: ITMG reported 9M26 net profit of US$162.93 million.

deals_control.event: Dato' Sri Tahir sells Maha Properti Indonesia shares
deals_control.headline: Tahir sells 33.89 million MPRO shares for Rp399.99 billion
deals_control.blurb: Maha Properti Indonesia said Tahir sold the shares on 9 November at Rp11,800 each, reducing his stake from 10.40% to 10.06%. He remains the company's controlling shareholder.
